svg.title: W1-03 Two Endings (learner)
svg.desc: Two panels with the same rising path of seven notes. The last two beats are hidden so the learner can hear both endings first.

svg.text: Learner view: hear first, then reveal

g.text: Same path both times. Only the last two beats differ.

svg.text: Listen to both. How does each ending leave you feeling? Your answer is yours.
Original AMF graphic, rendered from data (no AI-drawn notation). C4 = MIDI 60.
